title: WireSpec
description: A wire including its source, used by API/engine payloads (`POST /v1/wires {from,to,type}`).

WireType.description: What a wire permits. Wires are directional and stored on the *source* node.

oneOf.description: Read the target's data (`wheel read`, `table query`, `chest get|ls`, `secret get`, `run <script>`, MCP attachment).
Mutate the target's data. For `table` and `chest`, write **implies** read — see [`WireType::satisfies`].
Deliver a message to the target (agent→agent, endpoint→agent, script→agent) or, for `ctx`→`agent`, inject context into its prompt.
